summary: Cohen & Co Inc. filed an 8-K regarding the IPO of SPAC Columbus Circle Capital Corp. III (NASDAQ: CCCTU), which closed on July 10, 2026, selling 23,000,000 units at $10.00/unit for $230M gross proceeds, including full over-allotment. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share plus one-third warrant exercisable at $11.50. The sponsor purchased 265,000 placement units at $10.00 each, and Cohen's broker-dealer subsidiary, Cohen Company Capital Markets, acted as lead underwriter, converting its $3.6M fee into 360,000 placement units. The SPAC must complete a business combination within 24 months or liquidate. Watch for target announcements and extension votes.
